purpose: Rank and route data sources needed for proactive theme discovery before a theme becomes obvious in news headlines.

evidence_tiers.strong: Official filings, exchange data, company disclosures, audited financials, official macro/market data, and directly measurable market/flow data.
evidence_tiers.medium: Specialized industry media, trade publications, recognized research vendors, and structured third-party datasets that usually lead mainstream news but still need confirmation.
evidence_tiers.weak: Social posts, screenshots, forum threads, influencer notes, and rumor-like leads. These can start an investigation but cannot approve a thesis.

signal_families.company_truth: What the company actually does: products, business segments, customers, capex, capacity, margins, inventory, guidance, and risk factors.
signal_families.market_validation: Whether the market has started trading the basket: price, volume, relative strength, correlation, lead-lag, options, short interest, ETF flow.
signal_families.flow_and_chips: Who is buying or selling: Taiwan institutional flow, margin, shorting, ETF flow, northbound/southbound flow, CCASS, and insider/large-holder data.
signal_families.physical_constraint: Hard supply-chain evidence: pricing, lead time, utilization, shortages, capex, power, shipping, equipment orders, materials, and inventory.
signal_families.macro_liquidity: Liquidity and regime filters: rates, FX, credit, volatility, commodities, PMIs, central-bank policy, and inflation.
signal_families.lead_generation: Early hints: social posts, trade-media headlines, job posts, patents, procurement, and product launches.

priority_groups.name: Company truth and segment proof
priority_groups.why_it_matters: Prevents broad keyword mappings from becoming false stock-theme relations. This is the layer that distinguishes direct bottlenecks from sympathy names.

priority_groups.name: Market validation and lead-lag
priority_groups.why_it_matters: A real emerging theme should begin showing breadth, volume, relative strength, cross-market diffusion, or options/short-interest pressure.

priority_groups.name: Physical supply-chain constraints
priority_groups.why_it_matters: Explosive themes usually start when a real bottleneck forms before earnings catch up: price increases, lead-time extension, utilization spikes, capex or qualification constraints.

priority_groups.name: Macro liquidity and factor regime
priority_groups.why_it_matters: A good theme can fail as a trade if rates, FX, credit, volatility, or commodity pressure changes the risk budget.

priority_groups.name: Weak but fast lead generation
priority_groups.why_it_matters: Social and community feeds are useful only as early smoke detectors. They must trigger agentic verification against stronger sources.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs / company facts / submissions
sources.cadence: intraday for filings; quarterly/annual for facts
sources.theme_mining_use: Ground US company profiles, segment exposure, capacity/capex changes, and official catalyst verification.
sources.parser_strategy: Use ticker/CIK mapping, submissions JSON, companyfacts JSON, and filing text extraction. Cache raw filings and distilled segment facts.
sources.next_action: Add SEC connector to upgrade US company_profiles_seed and thesis cards.

sources.name: Nasdaq Trader symbol directory
sources.theme_mining_use: Clean US universe discovery and ETF/common-stock filtering before profile enrichment.
sources.parser_strategy: Download nasdaqlisted.txt and otherlisted.txt; filter test issues and non-common instruments unless explicitly needed.
sources.next_action: Keep as universe seed, but do not treat security-name keyword matches as business proof.

sources.name: Taiwan MOPS / TWSE open data: monthly revenue and filings
sources.cadence: monthly for revenue; event-driven for filings
sources.theme_mining_use: Detect revenue acceleration and validate whether Taiwan laggards have real earnings confirmation.
sources.parser_strategy: Use TWSE/TPEx open APIs where available; fall back to MOPS scraping for filings and annual reports.
sources.next_action: Promote monthly revenue into Lagradar candidate scoring and theme lifecycle stage.

sources.name: TWSE T86 foreign/investment-trust/dealer daily trading
sources.theme_mining_use: Confirm Taiwan theme diffusion and avoid names where price rises without institutional sponsorship.
sources.parser_strategy: Fetch daily T86 for TWSE; pair with TPEx equivalents for OTC names.
sources.next_action: Add chip_score to Lagradar for TW/TWO.

sources.name: Taiwan margin trading, short selling, disposal and abnormal trading data
sources.theme_mining_use: Measure crowding, squeeze potential, and late-stage retail climax in Taiwan themes.
sources.parser_strategy: Build per-symbol chip history and normalize by float/volume.
sources.next_action: Use as overheat/crowding gate in select_trade_candidates.py.

sources.name: JPX TDnet timely disclosures
sources.theme_mining_use: Detect Japan leader confirmation and product/capex disclosures before Taiwan/Korea sympathy catches up.
sources.parser_strategy: Use TDnet API if available; otherwise scrape public company announcement service and cache PDFs.
sources.next_action: Add JP disclosure watcher for leaders in electronics, power, batteries, materials and industrials.

sources.name: Japan EDINET API
sources.theme_mining_use: Ground Japanese company profiles, segment revenue, capex, equipment status and ownership changes.
sources.parser_strategy: Fetch document list by date, download XBRL/CSV/PDF, distill product segments and capacity clues.
sources.next_action: Use for Japan profile quality upgrades and large-shareholder/crowding checks.

sources.name: Korea OpenDART
sources.theme_mining_use: Validate Korean leaders such as Samsung SDI, LGES, SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, and component suppliers.
sources.parser_strategy: Use corp code list, filings search, document download and XBRL extraction.
sources.next_action: Add KR leader evidence path for battery, HBM, memory and display themes.

sources.name: HKEXnews issuer documents
sources.theme_mining_use: Validate Hong Kong/China ADR/H-share company profile, policy exposure and event catalysts.
sources.parser_strategy: Scrape issuer-document search, cache PDFs/HTML, classify announcements by type.
sources.next_action: Add HK disclosure parser for H-share/AH comparison candidates.

sources.name: HKEX CCASS shareholding data
sources.theme_mining_use: Track accumulation/distribution and crowding for HK laggards and China policy trades.
sources.parser_strategy: Use marketplace data if available; otherwise scrape public CCASS search for priority names.
sources.next_action: Evaluate cost and integrate only for high-priority HK universe.

sources.name: CNINFO / 巨潮资讯 listed-company announcements
sources.theme_mining_use: Validate A-share supply-chain names, policy themes, customer claims, and investor-relation Q&A leads.
sources.parser_strategy: Use CNINFO search APIs/pages, cache PDFs, classify announcements and extract product/customer/capex evidence.
sources.next_action: Add announcement-type classifier and connect to China/HK theme edges.

sources.name: Official company IR and product pages
sources.theme_mining_use: Upgrade business profiles and verify whether a ticker really owns the bottleneck layer.
sources.parser_strategy: Use Scrapling adaptive fetcher plus agentic source judge; cache source_pages and evidence rows.
sources.next_action: Prioritize profile_upgrade_queue by Lagradar candidate score and missing business evidence.

sources.name: Official exchange daily OHLCV where available
sources.theme_mining_use: Compute theme heat, relative strength, breakout, volume z-score, correlation and lead-lag.
sources.parser_strategy: Prefer official exchange data; use Yahoo chart as broad fallback with data-quality flags.
sources.next_action: Separate official_price vs yahoo_fallback quality flags in output manifests.

sources.name: Yahoo chart fallback
sources.theme_mining_use: Broad fallback for scans and backtests when official data is absent.
sources.parser_strategy: Cache aggressively, tag as fallback, and avoid treating missing/adjusted data as official evidence.
sources.next_action: Add data-quality warning when candidates rely only on Yahoo prices.

sources.name: FINRA / exchange short interest and short volume
sources.cadence: daily for short volume; bi-monthly for short interest
sources.theme_mining_use: Identify squeeze/crowding risk in high-beta emerging themes and avoid crowded shorts after huge moves.
sources.parser_strategy: Ingest by symbol/date, normalize by float and average volume.
sources.next_action: Add US crowding_score.

sources.name: Options open interest, implied volatility and skew
sources.theme_mining_use: Detect speculative demand and crowding; helps decide whether bull call spreads are expensive or cheap.
sources.parser_strategy: Optional connector via broker/export; keep separate from public reproducible pipeline.
sources.next_action: If IBKR connector is available, add read-only option-chain snapshots for watchlist names.

sources.name: TrendForce and industry price trackers
sources.theme_mining_use: Catch price-cycle turns in DRAM/NAND/panels/foundry and map to laggards across Korea, Taiwan, China and US.
sources.parser_strategy: Use public summaries as medium evidence and paid/exported details if available.
sources.next_action: Add industry_price_signal table keyed by product and date.

sources.name: DRAMeXchange / memory spot and contract price data
sources.theme_mining_use: Detect memory cycle acceleration before earnings and test Korea/Taiwan/US memory-stock diffusion.
sources.parser_strategy: Normalize product price series and join to memory concept nodes.
sources.next_action: Prioritize because user often tracks DRAM/legacy memory.

sources.name: SEMI equipment billings and semiconductor equipment reports
sources.theme_mining_use: Identify equipment-cycle turns and upstream capex beneficiaries.
sources.parser_strategy: Track report summaries, categories, and regional deltas; use as macro industry signal.
sources.next_action: Add as semicap cycle signal.

sources.name: WSTS / SIA semiconductor sales statistics
sources.theme_mining_use: Validate broad semiconductor cycle regime; prevents confusing single-stock noise with sector upcycle.
sources.parser_strategy: Store category/regional YoY/MoM as controls in Lagradar.
sources.next_action: Use as cycle filter for semis and components.

sources.name: The Elec trade media
sources.theme_mining_use: Early source for Korean electronics, battery, display, component and AI supply-chain bottlenecks.
sources.parser_strategy: Fetch article text, extract supplier-customer-product triples, then verify with official sources when possible.
sources.next_action: Promote trade-media triples into candidate edges with medium evidence tier.

sources.name: Nikkei Asia and Japanese industry reporting
sources.theme_mining_use: Early confirmation for Japan-led themes and Asia supply-chain relocation.
sources.parser_strategy: Use as medium evidence; avoid quoting subscription content beyond snippets.
sources.next_action: Add source fetch queue for JP/TW cross-market leaders.

sources.name: DigiTimes and Taiwan electronics supply-chain reporting
sources.theme_mining_use: Early signal for Taiwan electronics diffusion from global AI capex.
sources.parser_strategy: Use public titles/summaries and subscription exports when available; verify via monthly revenue and filings.
sources.next_action: Add headline watcher and evidence classifier.

sources.name: Customs / import-export / bill-of-lading datasets
sources.theme_mining_use: Find supplier-customer relationships and volume acceleration before company disclosure.
sources.parser_strategy: Optional paid ingestion; use only when legal/licensed and cite provider terms.
sources.next_action: Keep as future high-edge source, not required for public reproducibility.

sources.name: FRED macro data
sources.theme_mining_use: Regime filter for risk appetite, valuation pressure, USDJPY, and rate-sensitive growth themes.
sources.parser_strategy: Maintain macro series registry and cache observations with release dates.
sources.next_action: Add macro_regime.json for Lagradar risk-on/risk-off context.

sources.name: US Treasury yield curve data
sources.theme_mining_use: Control for duration pressure on growth/software/AI and USDJPY carry regime.
sources.parser_strategy: Fetch daily curve and compute changes, slope, and real-rate proxy.
sources.next_action: Pair with QQQ/SOXX/theme drawdown gates.

sources.name: CME/COMEX/NYMEX futures data
sources.theme_mining_use: Map commodity shocks into miners, materials, passive components, power equipment and inflation-sensitive sectors.
sources.parser_strategy: Use official/vendor data or ETF proxies when unavailable; record quality flags.
sources.next_action: Add commodity-to-theme shock model.

sources.name: Cboe volatility indices
sources.theme_mining_use: Risk regime and position sizing filter for aggressive laggard entries.
sources.parser_strategy: Cache daily values and compute percentile/regime labels.
sources.next_action: Add fear/crowding phase to daily market context.

sources.name: Central-bank calendars, statements and policy rates
sources.theme_mining_use: Interpret USDJPY, dollar strength, carry trades, and liquidity backdrop for equity themes.
sources.parser_strategy: Store calendar, statement diffs and policy-rate time series.
sources.next_action: Add policy-event calendar to macro context.

sources.name: X social leads
sources.theme_mining_use: Smoke detector for new bottleneck narratives such as BBU, InP, CPO, SOI, power and materials.
sources.parser_strategy: Never approve thesis directly; create investigation tasks against strong/medium sources.
sources.next_action: Keep as weak lead queue with source-corroboration requirement.

sources.name: Threads social leads
sources.theme_mining_use: Taiwan retail and KOL early narrative detection, especially electronics supply-chain concepts.
sources.parser_strategy: Manual screenshots or public pages only; require official/trade-media corroboration.
sources.next_action: Treat user-provided screenshots as weak leads and feed to agentic verification.

sources.name: Reddit investing and sector threads
sources.theme_mining_use: Find US small/mid-cap theme narratives and crowding risk.
sources.parser_strategy: Use as lead/crowding only, not business evidence.
sources.next_action: Optional; lower priority than official and trade data.

sources.name: PTT Stock forum
sources.theme_mining_use: Taiwan retail attention/crowding and early theme vocabulary discovery.
sources.parser_strategy: Track ticker/topic bursts; require price/chips/source confirmation.
sources.next_action: Optional after chip/official data is integrated.

sources.name: 雪球 / Chinese investor social leads
sources.theme_mining_use: China/HK narrative diffusion and policy-theme vocabulary discovery.
sources.parser_strategy: Use only as weak lead and crowding indicator.
sources.next_action: Optional after CNINFO/HKEX official data is integrated.

integration_roadmap.goal: Make public reproducible theme mining materially better without paid data.
integration_roadmap.deliverable: Official evidence rows for company profiles, revenue acceleration, disclosure catalysts and macro regime.

integration_roadmap.goal: Improve entry timing and avoid overheated themes.
integration_roadmap.deliverable: Crowding, chip and options confirmation signals in Lagradar.

integration_roadmap.goal: Detect physical constraints before earnings/news consensus.
integration_roadmap.deliverable: Product-level price/capacity/lead-time signals connected to graph concepts and supply-chain layers.

integration_roadmap.goal: Turn social chatter into investigation tasks, not unverified trades.
integration_roadmap.deliverable: Weak-lead queue that requires official/trade/price/flow corroboration.

minimum_viable_signal_stack: At least one strong or medium evidence item explaining the physical/business theme.
At least two markets or a clear upstream/downstream relation path.
Company profile with product specialization and constraints, not only sector labels.
Price/volume confirmation from the leader basket.
Candidate lag gap plus turn confirmation.
Crowding/overheat check from flow, margin, short interest, options, or volume extension.
